data.title: Robinhood Will Trade Stocks 24/7 Like Crypto. Does Bitcoin Lose Its Weekend Edge?
data.description: Robinhood just announced weekend stock trading, threatening to strip away one of Bitcoin's most distinctive bragging rights. But does round-the-clock availability actually protect crypto investors, or has that supposed edge always been more marketing than reality?
